purpose: Reproducible smoke/benchmark plumbing; not representative human speech recognition accuracy.

software.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

limitations: Single synthetic voice per language; not a human-recorded evaluation dataset.
Synthetic mixed-language pronunciation and noise do not establish real-world accuracy.
Compare models only on identical manifest/audio hashes and identical metric normalization.
Pinned software versions do not guarantee cross-platform byte identity; use the frozen hashes to identify an actual corpus.
Chinese WER is not linguistically segmented; use CER as the primary Chinese quality indicator.
